1.9.1 (beta 3, tested at the club):
- NOT READY: add a girl who is still getting ready; tap READY when she is. She keeps two times: Time in (came in) and Ready (the late fee goes by it). A reminder after 20 minutes.
- A girl added during the night joins at the next rotation.
- Champagne: + TIME is another sale (its own price, payment and split, its own line); Combo payment (cash + funny money).
- DJ screen: FIX SONG under the set timer, and AUTO NEXT: ON / PAUSED for tonight.
- House fees show her time in; PAID / UNPAID asks first.
